messages:
alex_m: Quick snapshot — console observability roadmap status and blockers before Thu milestone.
alex_m: Items: dashboards (skeleton merged), tracing hooks (PR open), error-analysis views (design), retention policy change (30 -> 90 days for prod). Need owners + infra deps.
maria.dev: I can own error-analysis views if no one else. Question: do we need new indices for the view?
jay_o: dashboards is on me, happy to keep iterating.
sara-ops: retention: security asked for 90 days for audits. current default is 30. storage & cost question.
leo: tracing hooks PR is ready: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4129 — needs one more review and a staging canary run. @infra-bot can you confirm canary slot?
infra-bot: canary slot estimated: available Wed 02:00 UTC. infra ticket created: RED-4567 (tracing + retention infra work).
maria.dev: re indices — yes, error-analysis needs a derived index for grouped errors. I'll add index creation to my PR.
alex_m: @maria.dev thanks — can you add the migration in the same PR or split? we prefer single PR if small.
maria.dev: will include migration. aiming for PR by EOD.
jay_o: small code review ping: @leo @maria.dev please glance at #4130 (dash widgets) — mainly layout changes.
leo: looking now, will comment inline.
sara-ops: question on retention rollout — can we tier retention by environment? prod=90, staging=30. Is that doable without extra infra cost spike?
infra-bot: tiered retention supported; need storage estimate. RED-4567 will include cost delta and timeline.
alex_m: Action list: dashboards owner= @jay_o, tracing hooks owner= @leo, error-analysis owner= @maria.dev, retention owner= @sara-ops; infra ticket = RED-4567; need reviews on PRs #4129, #4130, #4132.
jay_o: noted. I'll post small checklist in the dash PR for QA steps.
maria.dev: will post migration runbook and rollback plan in PR.
leo: I'll run the staging canary Wed and report results here.
alex_m: Thanks. If nothing blocks, aim to mark milestone ready Thu morning. :thumbsup:
sara-ops: ack, prepping audit justification for 90-day retention.
jay_o: :eyes:
maria.dev: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/console/pull/4147 — migration included.
leo: Reviewed and approved #4129, merging after CI.
infra-bot: RED-4567 updated with cost estimate; slack thread link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4567
alex_m: Great progress — closing this async check. If any urgent blockers ping me directly. Next sync Thu 10:00am PT.
